valuation_template_rationale: The common equity is dominated by binary clinical, regulatory, commercial, timing and dilution outcomes across an early-stage biotechnology pipeline, so risk-adjusted NPV is the permitted template-method pair that fits the issuer economics.
rating_change_conditions: Restore valuation support only after primary evidence bounds program-specific technical and approval probabilities, remaining development cost and timing, commercial pricing and penetration, partner milestone and royalty economics, future financing, Tempus obligations and fully diluted shares at commercialization, then supplies ordered bear, base and bull risk-adjusted-NPV assumptions with probabilities totaling 100. Upgrade only if the resulting expected-return, base-return, payoff and margin-of-safety gates clear; downgrade the thesis if clinical safety or efficacy disappoints, programs are terminated or deprioritized, partnership economics remain immaterial, burn accelerates or dilution overwhelms program value.
